title: BRING THEM IN

lines.text: Hark! tis the Shepherds voice I hear,
Out in the desert dark and drear,
Calling the sheep whove gone astray,
Far from the Shepherds fold away.
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandring ones to Jesus.
Wholl go and help this Shepherd kind,
Help Him the wandring ones to find ?
Wholl bring the lost ones to the fold,
Where theyll be sheltered from the cold ?
Out in the desert hear their cry,
Out on the mountains wild and high;
Hark! tis the Master speaks to thee,
"Go find My sheep whereer they be."
